ZIP-01 uses saved source rows and actual boundary features, with no invented coordinates. Line endings and trailing whitespace are normalized; source values are unchanged.

- `gazetteer.tsv`: selected unchanged rows from Census's [2021 Gazetteer](https://www2.census.gov/geo/docs/maps-data/data/gazetteer/2021_Gazetteer/2021_Gaz_zcta_national.zip), the complete 2020 ZCTA set. Census's release named 2020 predates that set.
- `geonames.tsv`: selected unchanged rows from [GeoNames US postal codes](https://download.geonames.org/export/zip/US.zip). GeoNames retains its own postal coordinates; Census internal points take precedence for ZIPs that have ZCTAs. CC BY 4.0; the publisher's README is saved here and reader attribution appears on `/transparency`.
- `postal-types.csv`: selected rows from the [Zipcodes national postal-type table](https://github.com/seanpianka/Zipcodes/blob/427e664995b5e0c7d44eab740ea5a46cb12f7581/scripts/data/zip_code_database.csv), supplied by unitedstateszipcodes.org. The repository's license is saved here. It identifies 73960 and 10540 as P.O. Box, and 05009 as unique with the institution listed as Veterans Administration. Types missing from that source remain null; they never silently become standard.
- `boundaries.json`: selected features extracted without geometry changes from Census [2020 ZCTA](https://www2.census.gov/geo/tiger/GENZ2020/shp/cb_2020_us_zcta520_500k.zip), [2023 place](https://www2.census.gov/geo/tiger/GENZ2023/shp/cb_2023_us_place_500k.zip), and [2023 county](https://www2.census.gov/geo/tiger/GENZ2023/shp/cb_2023_us_county_500k.zip) shapefiles. The join tests containment, including polygon holes, rather than using the nearest centroid. A point outside these shapes has a null mapping, while its postal place and coordinates remain available.
- `census-address.json`: the actual response from the [Census address lookup](https://geocoding.geo.census.gov/geocoder/locations/onelineaddress?address=1600%20Pennsylvania%20Ave%20NW,%20Washington,%20DC&benchmark=Public_AR_Current&format=json), for a public government office. Tests use these source coordinates to prove that address entry works independently of the mailing ZIP.
- `capture.json`: capture time and SHA-256 hashes of the full national downloads used to rebuild the committed tables.

`pnpm zcta:fetch` reads the national sources and refuses a Gazetteer that omits any ZIP in `data/derived/zip-governments.json`. `pnpm zcta:fetch --from DIRECTORY` uses saved downloads named `zcta.zip`, `US.zip`, `types-alt.csv`, `zcta-polygons.zip`, `place-polygons.zip`, and `county-polygons.zip`. The source-sample tests run offline.
